TS29571_CommonData.NfInstanceId.description: String uniquely identifying a NF instance. The format of the NF Instance ID shall be a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) version 4, as described in IETF RFC 4122.

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.SubscrCond.description: Condition to determine the set of NFs to monitor under a certain subscription in NRF

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NfInstanceIdCo.description: Subscription to a given NF Instance Id

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NfInstanceIdLi.description: Subscription to a list of NF Instances

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NfTypeCond.description: Subscription to a set of NFs based on their NF Type

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.ServiceNameCon.description: Subscription to a set of NFs based on their support for a given Service Name

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.ServiceNameLis.description: Subscription to a set of NFs based on their support for a Service Name in the Servic Name list

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.AmfCond.description: Subscription to a set of AMFs, based on AMF Set Id and/or AMF Region Id

TS29571_CommonData.AmfSetId.description: String identifying the AMF Set ID (10 bits) as specified in clause 2.10.1 of 3GPP TS 23.003. It is encoded as a string of 3 hexadecimal characters where the first character is limited to values 0 to 3 (i.e. 10 bits).

TS29571_CommonData.AmfRegionId.description: String identifying the AMF Set ID (10 bits) as specified in clause 2.10.1 of 3GPP TS 23.003. It is encoded as a string of 3 hexadecimal characters where the first character is limited to values 0 to 3 (i.e. 10 bits)

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.GuamiListCond.description: Subscription to a set of AMFs, based on their GUAMIs

TS29571_CommonData.Guami.description: Globally Unique AMF Identifier constructed out of PLMN, Network and AMF identity.

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NetworkSliceCo.description: Subscription to a set of NFs, based on the slices (S-NSSAI and NSI) they support

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NfGroupCond.description: Subscription to a set of NFs based on their Group Id

TS29571_CommonData.NfGroupId.description: Identifier of a group of NFs.

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NfGroupListCon.description: Subscription to a set of NFs based on their Group Ids

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NfSetCond.description: Subscription to a set of NFs based on their Set Id

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NfServiceSetCo.description: Subscription to a set of NFs based on their Service Set Id

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.UpfCond.description: Subscription to a set of NF Instances (UPFs), able to serve a certain service area (i.e. SMF serving area or TAI list)

TS29571_CommonData.Tai.description: Contains the tracking area identity as described in 3GPP 23.003

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.ScpDomainCond.description: Subscription to a set of NF or SCP or SEPP instances belonging to certain SCP domains

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NwdafCond.description: Subscription to a set of NF Instances (NWDAFs), identified by Analytics ID(s), S-NSSAI(s) or NWDAF Serving Area information, i.e. list of TAIs for which the NWDAF can provide analytics.

TS29571_CommonData.PlmnId.description: When PlmnId needs to be converted to string (e.g. when used in maps as key), the string shall be composed of three digits "mcc" followed by "-" and two or three digits "mnc".

TS29571_CommonData.Nid.description: This represents the Network Identifier, which together with a PLMN ID is used to identify an SNPN (see 3GPP TS 23.003 and 3GPP TS 23.501 clause 5.30.2.1).

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.MlAnalyticsInf.description: ML Analytics Filter information supported by the Nnwdaf_MLModelProvision service

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.VendorId.description: Vendor ID of the NF Service instance (Private Enterprise Number assigned by IANA)

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.VflCapabilityT.description: Type of Vertical Federated Learning Capability

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NefCond.description: Subscription to a set of NF Instances (NEFs), identified by Event ID(s) provided by AF, S-NSSAI(s), AF Instance ID, Application Identifier, External Identifier, External Group Identifier, or domain name.

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.PfdData.description: List of Application IDs and/or AF IDs managed by a given NEF Instance

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.IdentityRange.description: A range of GPSIs (subscriber identities), either based on a numeric range, or based on regular-expression matching

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.DccfCond.description: Subscription to a set of NF Instances (DCCFs), identified by NF types, NF Set Id(s) or DCCF Serving Area information, i.e. list of TAIs served by the DCCF

TS29571_CommonData.DateTime.description: string with format 'date-time' as defined in OpenAPI.

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NotificationEv.description: Types of events sent in notifications from NRF to subscribed NF Instances

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.NotifCondition.description: Condition (list of attributes in the NF Profile) to determine whether a notification must be sent by NRF

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.PlmnSnssai.description: List of network slices (S-NSSAIs) for a given PLMN ID

TS29571_CommonData.PlmnIdNid.description: Contains the serving core network operator PLMN ID and, for an SNPN, the NID that together with the PLMN ID identifies the SNPN.

TS29571_CommonData.Uri.description: String providing an URI formatted according to RFC 3986.

TS29510_Nnrf_NFManagement.LocalityType.description: Type of locality description. An operator may define custom locality type values other than those listed in this enumeration.

constraints.constraint: request_body.reqNfInstanceId MUST be a UUID version 4.
request_body.sharedDataIds MUST contain at least 1 item.
request_body.validityTime MUST be in date-time format.
request_body.reqNotifEvents MUST contain at least 1 item.
request_body.reqNfType MUST be one of the predefined NF types.
request_body.reqNfFqdn MUST be between 4 and 253 characters long.
request_body.reqSnssais MUST contain at least 1 item.
request_body.reqPerPlmnSnssais MUST contain at least 1 item.
request_body.reqPlmnList MUST contain at least 1 item.
request_body.reqSnpnList MUST contain at least 1 item.
request_body.servingScope MUST contain at least 1 item.
request_body.targetHni MUST be between 4 and 253 characters long.
request_body.extPreferredLocality MUST have at least 1 property.
